note: Styles recovered from actual deployed releases. Scroll-lock/announcement/VIP page-ID scoping was made component-wide for the single-release migration; other recovered declarations are unchanged except for the patches listed below.

sources.tdb-smile-feed.css: Home native Smile Gallery export on 2026-10-15, scoped to the external feed with one shared presentation
sources.tdb-review-cards.css: Home native Review Cards export, 2026-10-15; card dimensions, shared assets and motion retained
sources.tdb-vip-content.css: Published Home native form cascade, 2026-10-15; scoped to the deferred drawer body.
sources.tdb-announcement.css: Native Home announcement inner layout and breakpoints captured 2026-10-15, composed before existing shared announcement motion/states.

patches.tdb-instagram-native.css: 2026-10-15: reuse the shared TDB reveal fade and keep the stationary IG holder visible underneath until that same fade duration completes, matching Smiles. White video glyph uses the same SVG with a brightness/invert filter; the single shared focus-card badge retains its existing video-only visibility.
patches.tdb-smile-feed.css: 2026-10-15: reserve the native 3 em facts-row height in the shared summary with CSS padding; keep the treatment gap without restoring hidden per-card facts. Native Smile holding colour uses the existing orange-1 cream token. Delay hiding the stationary holder until the decoded gallery finishes its shared reveal fade.
patches.tdb-review-drawer.css: 2026-10-15: mirror the Webflow tdb-review-drawer_star native class mask/background/colour into this lazy CSS snapshot. The drawer is mounted after load, so its class is not emitted in the optimized initial page stylesheet. Preserve its existing size and is-empty opacity.
patches.tdb-review-cards.css: External proximity-loaded card template and CSS, permanent colour-matched holder through shared fade, one focus-only Read more action.
patches.tdb-ui.css: Shared feed holder geometry and existing native spinner arc; viewport base and phone landscape chrome retained only in the early critical stylesheet.
patches.tdb-vip-content.css: Form presentation loads on first open. Shared shell and footer Designer styles are retained for the other 24 drawer instances and the visible footer form.
patches.tdb-announcement.css: Home-only lazy mount receives the original layout via :where([data-tdb-announcement-lazy]); shell resting geometry remains native and other pages retain native markup.
